LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.Intro: RimBabel translates the texts of a mod and writes the result as a translation mod of its own. Nothing here changes a mod you have installed.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.Applies: Changes apply immediately and are saved when you close this window.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.ResetDesc: Restores every setting on this page, except your keys.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.EngineDesc: Each service needs its own key, except a server running on your own computer.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.EngineLibre: LibreTranslate (free, open source: your own server)
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.EngineMyMemory: MyMemory (free, no key, small daily allowance)
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.KeyDesc: Stored as plain text in the game's configuration folder, on this computer only. It is never written into a translation package.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.ModelDesc: The model name the service expects, for example claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 or qwen2.5.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.UrlDesc: The base address of the chat service, for example http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.BatchDesc: How many texts go to the service in one request. Fewer is gentler on a small local model; more is faster and cheaper.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.Problem.NoModel: This engine needs a model name.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.Problem.BadUrl: The server address is not a valid web address.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.Problem.NoFolder: This engine needs a folder identifier.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.OllamaPreset: Fill in for Ollama on this computer
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.OllamaPresetDesc: Sets the address and the model for a free Ollama server on this computer, with no key. Tools/Install-Ollama.ps1, in RimBabel's repository, installs Ollama and downloads that model.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.LibreUrlDesc: The address of your LibreTranslate server, for example http://localhost:5000. A key is only needed if that server asks for one.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.EmailDesc: Optional. When you provide an e-mail address, MyMemory raises its daily allowance. No other information is sent.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.FolderDesc: The identifier of the Yandex Cloud folder the key belongs to.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.TestDesc: Sends one short sentence through the chosen engine and shows what comes back, to check the key and the model.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.Author: Author name
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.AuthorDesc: Written into the About.xml of the packages you generate.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.LanguageDesc: The language into which packages are translated. By default, it is the language the game is running in.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.OutputDesc: Where packages are written. Leave it empty for the default folder, next to your saves.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.DictionaryDesc: One entry per line: word = required translation. Each entry applies to every mod, so the same word is translated the same way everywhere. A line starting with # is ignored.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.DictionaryBad.One: 1 line has no word or translation on either side of its equals sign, and is ignored.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.DictionaryBad.Many: {0} lines have no word or translation on either side of their equals sign, and are ignored.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.BlacklistDesc: One rule per line. A text is named K:key for a Keyed text, or D:DefType/defName.field for a Def text. Use * and ? as wildcards, or start the line with re: for a regular expression. A line starting with # is ignored.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.BlacklistBad.One: 1 rule is not a valid regular expression and matches nothing.
LanguageData.RimBabel.Settings.BlacklistBad.Many: {0} rules are not valid regular expressions and match nothing.
